name: shared-memory-manager
description: Universal memory management for ALL AI agents — QClaw, OpenClaw, EasyClaw, Qoder, and any SKILL.md-based system. Share, read, write, and sync user/project memories across machines with standardized formats.

interface.shortDescription: Share and manage memories across all AI agents
interface.longDescription: A universal memory management system that allows ALL AI agents — on any platform (QClaw, OpenClaw, EasyClaw, Qoder) — to share, read, write, and sync memories. Supports user-level and project-level memories with standardized formats and workflows.
